meta.title: Ricardo Barrios
meta.description: Ricardo Barrios is a systems engineer from Colombia focused on UX research and applied machine learning. Explore his projects, résumé and contact details.
meta.short: Systems engineer focused on UX research and applied ML, building helpful digital experiences.
meta.alt: Ricardo Barrios, systems engineer focused on UX research and applied machine learning

hero.alt: Interactive 3D ID badge for Ricardo Barrios García, UX Research + Applied ML (@dejesusbg), based in Colombia. Front side shows photo and primary role details. Back side reads: Loosely sketched in Figma and coded in Visual Studio Code by yours truly. Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, deployed with Netlify. All text is set in the Inter and Instrument Serif typefaces.

about.heading: About
about.body: I learned to [code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_development) just to build websites, and now [understanding](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_experience) how [people and machines](https://transformer-circuits.pub/2026/workspace/) behave is the part of [engineering](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Software_engineering) I'm best at.

featured.heading: Featured projects
featured.body: So, what do you want to see?

footer.heading: If you've read this far, say something ;)
footer.body: Open to [user research](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/User_experience) and [machine learning](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine_learning) roles, and being convinced otherwise. Always up for [side quests](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Start_up).
